note: Passages of the national development plan (January 2024). HMIS is named once, in policy action 13 under malaria, HIV/AIDS and TB: strengthen health system functions such as HMIS, supply chain management and outbreak response. The system is not described, so it is unclassified and no governance fact is recorded; a reader who accepts the name as the class could take this as a current plan (2024-2030) naming the HMIS.
